minecraft:written_book_content.title: Elevator Tech's Journal
minecraft:written_book_content.author: J. Ruiz
pages: {"text": "ELEVATOR TECH'S JOURNAL\n\nIf you're reading this: I didn't do it. Any of it. Read to the end."}
{"text": "On the trek in, a pillager raid hit the convoy. I fell down a bank into the mud.\nThat is the only reason I'm alive."}
{"text": "From the mud I saw it. A shimmer, like heat over a road. It walked through the pillagers like they were paper."}
{"text": "Then it picked up a ravager. With ONE ARM. It skinned it right there and took the head. Like a trophy.\nI stayed in that mud a long time."}
{"text": "The raid never reached camp. Nobody believed me. They said I hit my head."}
{"text": "Since then the elevator keeps breaking. Not breaking. Being taken apart. Bolts gone. Motor parts gone. Machines stripped.\nSomething is shopping."}
{"text": "I call it the ghost. You never see it. You see the jungle bend wrong. You hear clicking. Then something is missing."}
{"text": "Last night the crew had enough. They grabbed the rifles and went hunting it.\nThe ghost shimmered... and became a DEMON. A mask. Blades. Blue fire from its shoulder."}
{"text": "It was over in a minute. I was face down in a puddle of their blood, no gun, shaking.\nIt walked right up to me. Looked at me.\nThen it walked away."}
{"text": "It went to the foreman's office, tore the door off its hinges... and carried out the fridge.\nTHE FRIDGE."}
{"text": "I'm going into the jungle now. Anywhere but here.\nI wrote this so nobody blames me.\nI didn't strip the machines. I didn't take the fridge."}
